title: Field Security Advisor
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role We have created a new standard in cyber extortion incident response and are expanding our Cyber Readiness & Advisory Services team to continue evolving the retained client experience. We are looking for a Field Security Advisor to help us develop and deliver valuable content, tabletop exercises, and training workshops to our enterprise customers. In this role, you will work closely with our Customer Success team and Field CISO organization to help Global 2000 customers prepare executive, technical, finance, legal, and operational teams for the realities of handling a cyber extortion incident and improving organizational resiliency. Coveware is a fully distributed company with employees across multiple geographies. This is a remote role with global time zone flexibility. Candidates may be based in any geography as long as they can provide reliable overlap with customer time zones and travel periodically for customer on-sites and events. This is an individual contributor role. The role reports to the Senior Director, Field CISO within the Cyber Readiness and Advisory Services team. What You'll Do Deliver cyber extortion readiness engagements for retained enterprise customers, including executive briefings, technical workshops, and cross-functional training sessions. Design and facilitate tabletop exercises that reflect realistic cyber extortion conditions, operational disruption, ambiguous early facts, and executive decision points. Curate and continuously improve customer-facing content, including playbooks, decision frameworks, readiness checklists, and workshop materials, keeping deliverables aligned to current ransomware/extortion patterns. Conduct research and forensic data analysis to support advisory deliverables and customer insights, including synthesizing lessons learned from case trends and interpreting forensic outputs/artifacts (as available) into clear, actionable readiness recommendations. Support the customer lifecycle as needed, including customer due diligence requests, RFP/RFI questionnaires, and review of contracts/security exhibits in partnership with internal stakeholders. Collaborate internally with case management, SMEs, and other stakeholders to ensure readiness guidance stays grounded in real-world incident behavior and recovery constraints. Technologies You'll Work With Incident Response / Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) tools and methodologies Security Operations platforms and processes Cybersecurity advisory and consulting frameworks MITRE ATT&CK NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) CIS Controls Forensic analysis tools and artifacts Ransomware and cyber extortion readiness frameworks What You'll Bring 7+ years of experience in information security/cybersecurity, with depth in one or more of: Incident response / DFIR Security operations Cyber risk / security advisory / consulting 3+ years of customer-facing experience supporting B2B enterprise customers in advisory, incident readiness, cybersecurity, technology, or forensics-related services. Foundational knowledge of application, identity, cloud and network security concepts, and incident response best practices, ideally in a Global 2000 enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience presenting in a consultative manner to enterprise leadership and facilitating educational workshops and tabletop exercises. Ability to communicate complex topics clearly and authoritatively to diverse audiences, orally and in writing. Willingness and ability to travel for customer meetings, workshops, and events on occasion. Comfortable leading discussions with enterprise stakeholders across both technical and executive teams. Consultative/advisory mindset with structured problem framing, strong facilitation skills, crisp communication, and defensible recommendations. Strong listening skills with excellent written and verbal communication skills and willingness to deliver hard truths when needed to surface gaps and drive improvement. Strong, structured writing skills with experience producing executive-ready, evidence-based deliverables, translating complex inputs into clear narratives, prioritized recommendations, and defensible documentation. Bonus Skills One or more information security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, GCIH, GCFE, GCFA). Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Experience translating forensic findings and incident learnings into executive-ready narratives and prioritized readiness actions. Familiarity with frameworks/standards such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF and CIS Controls and how to apply them pragmatically to cyber defense and recovery. Experience collaborating with teammates to stay current on the threat landscape and continuously improve customer-facing materials. What you'll get Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning Compensation Transparency Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range. In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off. All your information will be kept confidential. Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice , which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing. By submitting your application, you confirm that the information provided, including any supporting documents, is complete and accurate to the best of your knowledge. title: Risk and Safety Section Head
description: Wood is recruiting for a Risk and Safety Section Head to join its Iraq business unit focusing on leading end‑to‑end site risk & safety management for oilfield operations. This role is a full-time on-site role in Basra, Iraq. Work Schedule: 28/28 Rotation #Wood #Iraq #Basra #Risk and Safety Section Head The role This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Risk and Safety Section Head to join our Iraq Business Unit. Our Clients and Projects Designing the future. Transforming the world. Wood is an integral part of operations in Iraq, and we are continuing to grow our footprint across the country. With a 90-year heritage, 10 major contracts and over 850 employees, we have the skills, expertise and asset knowledge to support clients to deliver energy security and decarbonisation ambitions. Wood excels in supporting our clients to deliver complex upstream and midstream oil and gas projects in Iraq delivering maintenance, modifications and engineering solutions. We are committed to decarbonising existing assets, producing cleaner energy and developing a sustainable national workforce, ensuring the long-term growth of the region. What we can offer Meaningful and interesting projects Delivered to high profile clients and complex projects in Iraq Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion ; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business with employee networks committed to giving all employees a voice Competitive salary with regular salary reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market Medical Insurance: Ensures inpatient and outpatient medical care is available should you require treatment. Commitment to continued professional development; development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests Global connections : join experts around the world who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession Job Purpose: Lead end‑to‑end site risk & safety management for oilfield operations including drilling, site construction, contractor activities and road safety. Supervise safety team, ensure full compliance with safety standards, conduct inspections & incident investigation, drive proactive safety culture and deliver safety improvement initiatives for multi‑facility oilfield sites. Key Functions & Activities: Oilfield Site Safety & Risk Control: Oversee safety operations across diverse oilfield work sites (drilling, construction, scaffolding, field mobile traffic etc.). Conduct site inspections, hazard identification and safety walkthroughs. Enforce compliance with safety procedures and safe work practices. Participate in incident root‑cause investigation and drive closure of corrective actions. Stakeholder & Contractor Safety Management: Supervise safety team performance; mentor staff and support competency development. Closely manage large contractor groups: deliver safety briefings, joint inspections, ensure contractor adherence to corporate safety requirements. Facilitate safety meetings, toolbox talks and safety workshops for site personnel and contractors. Act as backup support for HSE Manager. Team Management: Lead and manage the Risk and Safety Section team, fostering effective teamwork, collaboration, communication, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to achieve HSE objectives. Audit, Training & Emergency Preparedness: Lead safety audits, hazard hunts and performance monitoring across oilfield operations. Deliver safety inductions, safety campaigns and awareness training including VIP contractor inductions. Support emergency drills and incident response activities, promote continuous safety improvement across the site. Documentation & Reporting: Review and approve critical safety documents including risk assessments, JSAs and work permits. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly safety reports; track incidents, near‑misses, safety observations and safety KPIs. Maintain safety policies aligned with oilfield operational requirements. Qualifications What makes you remarkable? At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges. Expected: Education & Knowledge: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or safety‑related discipline Professional Certifications: Recognized HSE qualification such as NEBOSH, IOSH, CSP/CMIOSH or equivalent is preferred. ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 auditor or lead-auditor qualification and formal incident-investigation / risk-assessment training are desirable. Work Experience: Minimum 10 years safety operation experience, solid oil & gas / on‑shore oilfield or construction background. Proven track record leading safety teams and performing field inspections for complex high‑risk sites. Languages: English: fluent working proficiency. Arabic and/or Chinese language capability is an advantage. Technical Competencies: Good knowledge of international safety standards (ISO45001, OSHA). Strong incident investigation, risk assessment, audit and analytical problem‑solving skills. Excellent team supervision and cross‑party coordination capability. Others Requirements (If any): Ability to manage multi‑discipline safety teams covering drilling, scaffolding and site road safety; capable of working in dynamic high‑risk oilfield operating environment.

title: HSE Supervisor
description: INTECH Process Automation is seeking a skilled HSE Supervisor to join our Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team. The selected candidate will provide day-to-day HSE leadership at site, verifies that work is executed in accordance with approved HSE plans and procedures, identifies and controls hazards, monitors compliance with Permit to Work (PTW), LOTO and Job Safety Analysis/Risk Assessment requirements, and ensures timely reporting and close-out of unsafe conditions, incidents and nonconformances. ﻿Key Responsibilities: Provide day-to-day HSE leadership and field supervision for maintenance, project, shutdown, turnaround, and execution activities. Ensure compliance with COMPANY HSE procedures, legal requirements, PTW, LOTO, and approved work controls. Review and verify JSA/JHA, risk assessments, RAMS, method statements, and control measures, particularly for high-risk activities. Monitor and enforce safe execution of work at height, confined space, lifting, hot work, excavation, electrical work, pressure testing, chemical handling, SIMOPS, and energy isolation. Conduct regular site HSE inspections and audits, identify unsafe conditions and environmental issues, and ensure corrective actions are effectively closed. Conduct/support toolbox talks, safety briefings, HSE awareness activities, and workforce engagement. Respond to and support investigation of incidents, near misses, emergencies, and environmental events, including root-cause analysis and corrective actions. Support emergency preparedness, drills, response plans, and emergency equipment readiness. Monitor contractor and subcontractor HSE performance, including competency, documentation, PTW, PPE, LOTO, lifting, and other critical controls. Monitor environmental compliance, including waste management, chemical handling, spill prevention, housekeeping, and environmental incident reporting. Maintain accurate HSE reports, inspection/audit records, PTW records, incident reports, observations, training records, corrective-action registers, and HSE statistics. Identify recurring HSE risks and recommend preventive and continuous-improvement measures. Requirements: To Be Successful in This Role, You Must Have: Technical Degree/Dimploma in HSE, Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related discipline, with a recognized HSE certification. Minimum 5 years of oil & gas experience, including at least 3 years as an HSE Supervisor or equivalent. Experience in maintenance, brownfield projects, shutdowns, turnarounds, or operating facilities preferred. Strong knowledge of HSE leadership, hazard identification, risk assessment, JSA/JHA, RAMS, PTW, LOTO, SIMOPS, and high-risk work controls. Experience in incident/near-miss investigation, root-cause analysis, emergency response, HSE inspections, audits, and corrective-action management. Competent in contractor HSE management, environmental controls, HSE reporting, statistics, and workforce engagement. Relevant certifications such as NEBOSH/IOSH, First Aid/CPR, Fire Fighting, Incident Investigation, PTW/LOTO, Confined Space, and Work at Height are preferred. Strong safety leadership, communication, decision-making, problem-solving, and reporting skills, with the confidence to challenge and stop unsafe work. Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary, multicultural teams and under operational/schedule pressure. Demonstrated commitment to COMPANY HSE requirements, continuous improvement, and proactive hazard prevention. ﻿We Offer Competitive Benefits: Global Exposure: Opportunities to work on international projects and collaborate with global teams. Competitive Compensation: A salary package that recognizes your expertise and contributions. Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical insurance for you and your dependents. Learning Opportunities: Access to training programs, workshops, and certifications to enhance your skills. Inclusive Environment: A workplace that celebrates diversity and fosters collaboration. Why Join INTECH Automation Intelligence? At INTECH, you will have the opportunity to work with a globally renowned industrial automation and digitalization technology company. For nearly 30 years, INTECH has partnered with major oil and gas global giants to deliver innovative solutions. As we continue to lead in the Industry 4.0 era, you will be at the forefront of transformative technologies that solve real-world challenges. ﻿What to Expect After Applying? Explore how INTECH ensures a seamless hiring journey. From embracing talent with a passion for innovation to fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth, we’re dedicated to finding and supporting the best minds in the industry. Click Here to learn more about our hiring process and discover your path to success with us. Our hiring process is designed to assess your skills and potential in a fair and inclusive manner. After applying, you will be guided through a structured evaluation process to ensure mutual alignment. INTECH Automation Intelligence is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Environment Health Safety Lead
description: About Us PEG is an international engineering and contracting company with a presence across selected strategic geographies. With over 50 years of proven experience , PEG delivers process design, engineering solutions, and project management services across the Oil & Gas, Power Generation, and Renewables sectors. Our capabilities cover the full project lifecycle, from conceptual and front-end engineering design (FEED) and feasibility studies through detailed engineering, construction, commissioning and start-up, to operations and maintenance . About the Role Location: Iraq/ Basra and other project Locations Position: HSE Lead Key Responsibilities: Developing and implementing comprehensive health, safety, and environmental policies in accordance with legal and corporate guidelines. Conducting risk assessments to identify potential hazards and developing preventative strategies. Organizing safety training for employees to ensure awareness and understanding of safety and environmental practices and legislation. Monitoring compliance with policies, performing site inspections, and preparing detailed reports on findings. Leading emergency response initiatives and conducting investigations after incidents to establish causes and preventive measures. Advising on a range of specialist areas, e.g., fire regulations, hazardous substances, noise, occupational diseases, and waste management. Maintaining current knowledge of legislation and regulatory requirements related to health, safety, and environmental matters that impact the organization. Collaborating with internal leadership and external regulatory bodies to maintain compliance standards. Implementing health and safety plans that comply with company policies and legislated standards. Overseeing environmental performance and adherence to legal environmental standards. Handling safety/regulatory audits both internally and externally. Coordinating with HR departments to ensure physical examinations and medical clearances are completed per the company's policies. Developing and maintaining documentation related to HSE initiatives, such as inspection forms and training modules. Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Safety Management, or a related field. NEBOSH IGC certification Professional certifications such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) are highly desirable. Strong understanding of the legal health and safety guidelines relevant to the industry. Several years of experience in a HSE role, ideally within the industry or a closely related field. Proficient use of HSE management software and tools. What We Offer: Opportunity to work on strategically important Oil & Gas projects. International and multicultural working environment. Competitive compensation package. Professional growth and leadership opportunities within a dynamic project organization.

title: HSE Professional (Flexible Plant)

Ensure safe operation and maintenance of flexible plant equipment. Inspect fire protection equipment and fixed firefighting systems. Monitor and maintain Zeta fire alarm systems. Implement electrical safety measures, including static electricity hazard controls. Conduct safety inspections, risk assessments, and awareness activities. Support emergency preparedness and fire prevention measures. Requirements Minimum 3 years of HSE experience specifically in a Flexible Plant. Strong knowledge of flexible plant machinery, operations, and maintenance. Good understanding of fire hazards associated with flexible plant operations. Familiarity with fire protection equipment, including fixed firefighting systems. Experience with Zeta fire alarm systems. Knowledge of electrical safety, static electricity hazards, and control measures. Relevant HSE certifications. Nationality is open. Position level will depend on qualifications and professional experience.
